title: Pilot button
description: A pill button set in uppercase monospace: butter-yellow that turns violet on hover, solid violet that darkens, or a 1px outline (light on dark bands, violet on light) that fills on hover. Optional leading icon.
notes: outline-light is meant for dark bands (it uses the secondary-foreground colour)
name: pilot-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
sun: yellow fill → violet on hover · solid: violet fill → darker ·
outline-light: light outline on dark bands → light fill · outline: violet outline → violet fill

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon before the label (e.g. a play triangle)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
